nodes.label: Constitutional Classifiers
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Constitutional Classifiers- Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming.pdf
nodes.author: Mrinank Sharma; Meg Tong; Jesse Mu; et al. (Anthropic Safeguards Research Team)

nodes.label: Universal Jailbreak
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Constitutional Classifiers- Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming.pdf
nodes.rationale: A prompting strategy that reliably bypasses safeguards across the vast majority of queries in a domain, effectively converting a model into one without safeguards; focus is CBRN misuse uplift for non-experts.

nodes.label: Constitution (Natural-Language Rules)
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Constitutional Classifiers- Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming.pdf
nodes.rationale: Natural-language rules specifying permitted and restricted categories; being natural language it can be rapidly updated to adapt to new threat models, and specifying permitted categories limits over-refusals.

nodes.label: Constitution-Guided Synthetic Data
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Constitutional Classifiers- Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming.pdf
nodes.rationale: LLMs prompted with the constitution generate vast labeled training data; fine-tuning classifiers on it addresses vulnerabilities systematically and cuts overhead vs prompted classifiers.

nodes.label: Streaming Dual-Classifier Defense
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Constitutional Classifiers- Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming.pdf
nodes.rationale: Input-only plus streaming output-only classifiers form a swiss-cheese defense; streaming enables real-time halting of harmful generation at any token while preserving latency.

nodes.label: 3000+ Hours Human Red Teaming
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Constitutional Classifiers- Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming.pdf
nodes.rationale: 405 participants via a HackerOne bug-bounty (up to $15K) found no universal jailbreak against the guarded system; classifiers add only 0.38% refusals and 23.7% inference overhead.
